data.status: candidate analysis of MODELLED suitability in the mountain domain (not observed change, not migration, not climate causality)

decisions.speciesRule: modelled and >= 30 thinned presences inside the mountain mask
decisions.threshold: max TSS on the out-of-fold predictions of the spatial-block CV (rows with an OOF value for every member)

extrapolation.definition: any predictor of the variant outside its range over the training rows (target-group cells)

novel_future_counted_unsuitable.rule: future suitable cells whose climate is outside the training range are counted as unsuitable; current area unchanged (a conservative bound: no gain is trusted where the models extrapolate)

richness.definition: number of the eligible species whose ensemble suitability is at or above its out-of-fold threshold; future = mean over the GCMs of a period and SSP

upperLimit.rule: species whose current suitable cells cover >= 90 % of Kapos class 2 (3500-4500 m)

reproduction.rule: passed = same members for every species, out-of-fold threshold within rounding (5e-5), and every stored area_change_pct and elevation_shift_m reproduced within 0.05, i.e. within the rounding of the stored values (0.1)

data.bootstrap: percentile bootstrap of the median over species, 10000 resamples, seed 20261114 combined with crc32 of the key

checks.note: masked: area with future suitable cells in novel climate counted as unsuitable; elevation inside cells that are familiar now and in the scenario
